messages:
maya: ran onboarding golden-run for phoenix-int8-ptq. strict funcall pass dropped 99.0% -> 88.7% on long kvcache prefixes (>=1200 tokens). failing samples show a WORD JOINER (U+2060) injected inside a JSON key and a stray 0x80 byte emitted mid-array.

rick: ouch. reproducible on mirror?

maya: yes, mirrored on replica-2. only when streaming+retries and long prefixes. pasted a trimmed emission below.

```
{"tool":"classify","args":{"items":[{"id":3,"label":"ok"}]}}
⁠
```

anil: token dump shows nearby hex sequence "... 0x5c 0x80 0x1f ..." where the reference decoder emits 0x20 instead. looks like a decode-LUT offset for the int8 PTQ kernel.

katie: did we see anything like this in prior quant bring-ups?

anil: similar surface to past signed/unsigned LUT issues but different invisible char (U+2060). this one only sparks when prefix length crosses a boundary and retries concatenate chunks.

maya: also noticed router sometimes delivers duplicate funcall events when a retry happens before downstream ack. duplicates + malformed JSON = downstream errors.

rick: infra-bot, kick off a targeted canary and open tickets.

infra-bot: Canary started: ci/phoenix-ptq-377 (sharded + non-sharded replay). logs: https://ci.redwood/phoenix/377.

infra-bot: Created RWI-2301 (block phoenix-int8-ptq on Dedicated), RWI-2302 (schema-delta alert), RWI-2303 (funcall idempotency).

anil: i'll diff decoder LUT blobs & compile flags between sharded/non-sharded and host reference. i own root-cause triage (ETA EOD).

katie: i'll prototype a canary-only sanitizer (map U+2060 -> space, drop 0x80) and measure perf; apply only to replays for now.

maya: i'll attach tokenizer dumps, seeds, and failing traces to RWI-2301. gist: https://gist.redwood/g/phoenix-377-repro

rick: agreed block Dedicated until fix, add schema alert for delta > 2%, and add a unit test in compile CI that diffs decode LUTs.

anil: if it's a compile-time define bug i'll patch pipeline today.

katie: perf impact estimate for sanitizer ~0.5ms per request; will validate in bench. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all, will update when canary finishes or when root cause found.
